vocabulary_focus.concept: To follow up / I will follow up

expressions.bm_formal: Saya akan susulan / Saya akan maklumkan semula
expressions.bm_casual: Saya akan follow up / Nanti saya update

expressions.cn: 我们安排个会议/时间吧
expressions.bm_formal: Mari kita jadualkan mesyuarat / Mari kita tetapkan masa
expressions.bm_casual: Jom set meeting / Jom arrange masa

expressions.en: Could you please elaborate? / Can you explain more?
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh anda terangkan dengan lebih lanjut? / Mohon huraikan
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh explain lagi? / Cuba cerita detail sikit?

vocabulary_focus.concept: Apologize for inconvenience / Sorry for the trouble

expressions.bm_formal: Saya memohon maaf atas kesulitan ini / Maaf atas kesulitan yang timbul

vocabulary_focus.concept: Thank you for your cooperation / Thanks for helping

expressions.bm_formal: Terima kasih atas kerjasama anda / Penghargaan atas bantuan anda
expressions.bm_casual: Thanks for the cooperation / Terima kasih tolong

work.scenario: You are in a project meeting discussing deadlines. Your manager asks for an update on a specific task and wants confirmation on its completion date. You assure them you will follow up with the team and thank everyone for their input.
key_phrases: Sila sahkan tarikh siap projek itu.
Saya akan susulan dengan pasukan dan maklumkan semula.
Terima kasih atas kerjasama anda semua.

life.scenario: You're trying to organize a dinner with friends. One friend is confused about the location, and you need to apologize for the last-minute change. You suggest setting a time that works for everyone.
key_phrases: Maaf ya, ada perubahan lokasi last minute.
Boleh explain lagi pasal lokasi baru ni?
Jom arrange masa yang sesuai untuk semua.

tech.scenario: You're on a call with tech support because your new software isn't working. The agent asks you to perform a step and then asks you to confirm if it worked. You need to ask them to elaborate on the next step and promise to update them after trying.
key_phrases: Boleh confirmkan kalau langkah ni dah berjaya?
Boleh explain lagi tak apa langkah seterusnya?
Nanti saya update semula lepas saya cuba.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you formally ask 'Please confirm the details' in Malay? (请确认详细信息)
If you want to casually say 'I'll follow up on this' to a colleague, what would you say in Malay? (我会跟进这件事)
quiz_toggle.answer: Saya akan follow up pasal ni.

quiz_toggle.question: What's a formal way to suggest 'Let's schedule a meeting next week' in Malay? (我们下周安排个会议吧)
quiz_toggle.answer: Mari kita jadualkan mesyuarat minggu depan.

quiz_toggle.question: How do you casually ask 'Can you explain more about this feature?' in Malay? (你能详细说明一下这个功能吗？)
quiz_toggle.answer: Boleh explain lagi pasal feature ni?

quiz_toggle.question: You need to formally apologize for a delay. How would you say 'I apologize for the inconvenience caused' in Malay? (我为造成的不便道歉)
quiz_toggle.answer: Saya memohon maaf atas kesulitan yang berlaku.

quiz_toggle.question: How would you casually express 'Thanks for your cooperation' to a team member in Malay? (感谢您的合作)
